enchantment.minecraft.protection.desc: Increases the defensive abilities of your armor and decreases physical damage taken.
enchantment.minecraft.respiration.desc: Enhances underwater abilities and allows you to hold your breath for an extended period.
enchantment.minecraft.aqua_affinity.desc: Enhances your mining speed whilst underwater.
enchantment.minecraft.thorns.desc: Wraps your armor in a layer of natural barbs, immediately dealing a small portion of damage back to your attackers.
enchantment.minecraft.sharpness.desc: Imbues your weapon with enhanced abilities to increase its damage and cut deeper into your enemy's soul.
enchantment.minecraft.knockback.desc: Increases the power of your weapon allowing for more devastating blows, knocking your enemy back further
enchantment.minecraft.fire_aspect.desc: Imbues your weapon with a flaming strike
enchantment.minecraft.looting.desc: Allows you to salvage rarer and larger amounts of resources from enemies.
enchantment.minecraft.efficiency.desc: Refines your tools allowing them to mine quicker than normal.
enchantment.minecraft.silk_touch.desc: Allows you to collect more precious materials from the blocks you mine.
enchantment.minecraft.unbreaking.desc: Increases the structurable stability of your equipment in turn allowing it to last vastly longer.
enchantment.minecraft.fortune.desc: Grants you the chance to occasionally obtain double resources from certain blocks.
enchantment.minecraft.power.desc: Imbues your arrows with enhanced abilities to increase it's damage and pierce deeper into your enemy's soul.
enchantment.minecraft.luck_of_the_sea.de: Grants you the blessing of Verul and increases your fishing luck and abilities.
enchantment.minecraft.lure.desc: Further entices the aquatic creatures and makes them bites your hook more often.
enchantment.minecraft.depth_strider.desc: Enhances your swimming speed and abilities.
enchantment.minecraft.frost_walker.desc: Forms a layer of glacial ice under your feet.
enchantment.minecraft.mending.desc: You're a dirty fucking cheater, you.
enchantment.minecraft.sweeping.desc: Turns your attacks into sweeping strikes, allowing you to hit multiple enemies at once.
enchantment.minecraft.loyalty.desc: Calls your trident back to your hand after piercing an enemy.
enchantment.minecraft.impaling.desc: Enhances attacking capabilities against aquatic enemies.
enchantment.minecraft.riptide.desc: Transforms your trident throw into a piercing dash, dealing high damage to anyone in your way.
enchantment.minecraft.channeling.desc: Calls down a lightning strike at the location of your trident.
enchantment.minecraft.multishot.desc: Summons two additional spectral arrows that deal a fraction of the original damage for the same cost.
enchantment.minecraft.quick_charge.desc: Increases your efficiency with a crossbow and allows you to load one quicker than normal.
enchantment.minecraft.piercing.desc: Sharpens your arrow heads and lets them pierce multiple enemies at once.
enchantment.minecraft.soul_speed.desc: Utilizes the souls at your feat propelling you further with each step,
enchantment.minecraft.swift_sneak.desc: Increases your movement speed while in stealth.
